sobre.heroTitulo: Brazilian technology to protect and understand assets.
sobre.heroTexto: AIP develops artificial intelligence and computer vision solutions for companies, institutions and the public sector. We turn camera footage into security, advanced monitoring and efficiency for every operation.
sobre.heroAlt: Operator seen from behind in a dark room, facing a wall of screens with camera feeds and maps analyzed by artificial intelligence
sobre.inovacaoTitulo: The most advanced technology in the world, built for Brazil.
inovacaoTextos: AIP's solutions come from research by our team of specialists, combined with international experience from people who closely follow the computer vision technologies used by major companies, intelligence services and governments around the world.
One of our directors brings that experience to Brazil, and our team turns it into solutions adapted to our cities, our climate, our laws and the needs of each operation.

We believe Brazil should develop its own technology, not just import it. Every AIP solution is designed, configured and supported by a Brazilian team, contributing to the country's digital sovereignty.

sobre.paisesAlt: Outlines of the United States, Europe, Russia, China and Israel, connected by a line to Brazil

faq.p: Do I need to replace my current cameras?
faq.r: Not necessarily. Cameras that meet the technical requirements can be used. We assess your setup before deployment.

faq.p: Does it work at night?
faq.r: Yes, within the camera's limits. Performance depends on lighting and image quality.

faq.p: Does AIP use facial recognition?
faq.r: Yes. AIP identifies people by their faces, with a technical and legal review of each application, according to its purpose and the applicable law. People can also be found by features such as clothing and colors.

faq.p: How long does deployment take?
faq.r: It depends on the number of cameras, the infrastructure and the configuration needed. After the technical assessment, we give you the timeline for your project.

faq.p: Does AIP only serve the sectors shown on the website?
faq.r: No. The sectors on the website are examples. We work with any operation that uses cameras and build custom solutions for each need. Tell our team about your case.

faq.p: Who can access the system?
faq.r: Access is organized by profiles and permissions. Each person sees only what they need.

faq.p: Can the Totem replace a conventional installation?
faq.r: In many cases, yes. It combines cameras, processing and connectivity in a single structure, ideal for places without infrastructure or that need extra coverage. We assess each site before installation.

faq.p: How does it connect?
faq.r: The Totem connects to the AIP platform via 4G or the local network, depending on what is available at the installation site.

faq.p: Is the Totem connected to the police?
faq.r: Yes. Besides our 24/7 monitoring center, the Totem can be integrated with public security agencies, such as the state and federal police, municipal guards and integrated security centers, depending on each project.

faq.p: Can it be used temporarily?
faq.r: Yes. Events, construction sites and temporary operations can be covered, depending on installation conditions.

faq.p: How is data handled?
faq.r: We comply with Brazil's data protection law (LGPD), with a defined purpose, access profiles, audit logs and configurable retention. Facial recognition is applied according to each project's purpose and the applicable law.
